LESSON: READING 15.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: POEMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.4: Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to relate ideas read in works of art to real life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life
2. identify the key elements of an email
3. apply the elements in writing an email

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life
   In simple words: practise until you can explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. identify the key elements of an email
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the key elements of an email. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. apply the elements in writing an email
   In simple words: practise until you can apply the elements in writing an email. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems.
4. Show that you can: explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 15.4.1 Intensive reading: Poems important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read given grade appropriate poems about tourist attraction sites (world) for enjoyment,
2. Discuss the meaning of the poems in groups,
3. Effective communication: It is developed as the learner discusses the meaning of the selected poems in groups.
4. Rework their emails to include any elements that were missing,
5. Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner exchanges emails with their friends Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to relate ideas read in works of art to real life?
2. What is the role of poems in the society?
3. Why do we write emails?
4. What is the difference between emails and letters?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain why it is important to relate ideas learnt in poems to real life
2. identify the key elements of an email
3. apply the elements in writing an email

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
